instalacionBase.nombre: Central AI Mini-PC — mandatory base installation
instalacionBase.tagline: The system that connects and coordinates your home.
instalacionBase.resumen: Before any mode, the Central AI Mini-PC is installed once: the brain that links all modes together, the control dashboard and the WhatsApp Business API integration. Available in two tiers depending on how many AI services the customer wants — see the comparison above. From here, each added mode is a fixed extra cost, the same in both tiers.
